title: Are LLMs Court-Ready? Evaluating Frontier Models on Indian Legal Reasoning
findings: The paper does not provide any findings related to religion. Its analysis focuses on general legal reasoning capabilities and does not disaggregate performance based on legal topics such as religious law.

measurement_description: The benchmark indirectly measures knowledge of Hindu laws as one of many subjects within the Delhi Higher Judicial Services (DHJS) Preliminary exam syllabus. The paper's analysis does not focus on or evaluate performance on this specific religious component.
